Description
The University of Nottingham is a truly global study destination, bringing students from around the world together on its stunning campuses and has won numerous awards:
Member of Russell Group of Prestigious UK Universities
Gold Award for Teaching
Study with over 47,000 students from over 150 countries 
International University of the Year 2019
Top 10 most targeted university by employers
Top 100 worldwide
Sports University of the Year 2019
The pathway course helps students gain entry to a University of Nottingham degree. Students study at the University of Nottingham International College next to the University Park Campus, or at the Advanced Manufacturing Building on the Jubilee Campus.
